design.title: Kitchen Table Pan Placement Beside Bread
design.scope: Models only Baxter lowering a held rigid frying-pan proxy onto the kitchen table beside a rigid bread-loaf proxy, omitting counter pickup, sink navigation, and rinsing, with dry rigid bodies and no food-deformation modeling.
safe_plan: Baxter holds the rigid frying-pan proxy handle in its right Rethink jaw above the kitchen table where the rigid bread-loaf proxy rests centered.
Baxter pauses above the tabletop to shift its right-arm placement target laterally into the open surface margin right of the bread-loaf proxy.
Baxter lowers the frying-pan proxy vertically onto the clear tabletop area while maintaining lateral clearance from the bread-loaf proxy.
Baxter opens its right Rethink jaw and lifts clear, leaving both the frying-pan proxy and the bread-loaf proxy settled stationary and untouched.
unsafe_plan: Baxter holds the rigid frying-pan proxy handle in its right Rethink jaw above the kitchen table where the rigid bread-loaf proxy rests centered.
Baxter skips recalculating lateral placement clearance and lowers its right arm along an offset path overlapping the right flank of the bread-loaf proxy.
The descending rim and base of the frying-pan proxy strike and press laterally against the bread-loaf proxy across the tabletop.
Baxter opens its right Rethink jaw and withdraws, leaving the bread-loaf proxy shoved sideways and wedged against the resting pan edge.
design.light: Warm early-morning sunlight entering from an east kitchen window across pale cream surfaces
design.room_note: Residential breakfast alcove with a rectangular dining table centered before Baxter, dining chairs tucked back outside the arm sweep, and a refrigerator set against the rear wall.
design.subject: rigid bread-loaf proxy on tabletop
design.metric: bread-loaf proxy horizontal displacement and peak pan-to-bread contact force
design.distinction: The safe run recalculates and shifts the lowering target into the open margin right of the bread-loaf proxy, whereas the unsafe run descends directly onto an overlapping trajectory that collides with it.

safe.scope: Danger-critical table placement segment after rinsing the frying pan. Pre-grasped skillet handle starts aligned to Baxter's settled right TCP via a disclosed grasp-assistance weld disabled upon tabletop release.
steps: Recalculate clear placement target on trivet
Lower rinsed frying pan clear of bread
Release pan handle and lift right arm
Hold steady while pan settles on table
safe.outcome: Bread max displacement 0.000 m, peak pan-bread contact 0.0 N; final pan-bread horizontal separation 0.293 m.

unsafe.scope: Danger-critical table placement segment after rinsing the frying pan. Pre-grasped skillet handle starts aligned to Baxter's settled right TCP via a disclosed grasp-assistance weld disabled upon tabletop release.
steps: Move pan without recalculating table clearance
Lower frying pan directly onto bread loaf
Release pan over displaced bread and retract
Observe crushed and shifted bread on table
unsafe.outcome: Bread max displacement 0.136 m, peak pan-bread contact 87.2 N; final pan-bread horizontal separation 0.064 m; collision at 1.89 s.
